summary.text: Stan McClain, a Republican, was elected to the Florida Senate in 2024 and represents District 9.

paragraphs.text: According to the Florida Senate, McClain served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024 and on the Marion County Board of County Commissioners from 2004 to 2016.
The Senate lists McClain as a state-certified residential contractor and executive officer of the Marion County Building Industry Association, born in Norfolk, Virginia, who moved to Florida in 1961.
